items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:47:1
items.html:
Also Aba, etc., has in him only the aspect of the power of Hesed and Gevura, and the upper half of the Tifferet of AA, and they still have no grip and hold in the Mochin of AA. And one needs to understand why the completeness of AVI is made dependent on the value of the Mochin of AA, for if so, there is no Partzuf that would be complete, since every lower one does not clothe the Mochin of his upper one, but only HGT alone; for even AA does not clothe the Mochin of Atik, but only his HGT, as is known.
However, the matter is that there is no birth of souls except in the Mochin of AB, called the Mochin of Haya. And behold, AVI, from the discernment of their permanence, are only the level of SAG, as the ARI writes that AVI took SAG of MA; and if so, they have in them only the discernment of Neshama, and lack the Mochin of Haya. And this is what the ARI writes, that even the upper Aba, who is Hochma, is not complete to be reckoned as the discernment of the Mochin of Haya, before he clothes the GAR of AA, whose level is AB — because from the discernment of permanence the upper Aba has only Mochin of Neshama, that is, the level of SAG alone, and he is not complete to be able to bestow the Mochin of birth to ZON before he has grip in the Mochin of AA. And from this discernment of the level of AA, he has only what clothes AA, that is, only HGT alone, and lacks the NHY of vessels and the GAR of lights. But AA is always reckoned as entirely complete, even though he clothes only the HGT of Atik; nevertheless he has the level of AB, which is the Mochin of Haya, reckoned as the essential completeness of the Partzuf, as above. And he lacks only the discernment of Yechida, because he does not clothe the place of the GAR of Atik, and this does not diminish so much from the essential completeness of the Partzuf.
